prompt_video:
Podcast-style video. Static camera, medium close-up framing locked to the start frame throughout; she keeps the exact face of the start frame and always looks toward her friend on the right side of the image, never at the camera. She speaks to someone off-camera, delivering two lines with one natural pause between them.

No captions. No background music. No camera movement or angle changes.

Realism: she looks and moves like a real woman filmed on a real podcast, never like AI: natural blinking, visible breathing, micro-expressions in her eyes, eyebrows and mouth, small head tilts and nods, hands and shoulders moving with what she feels, lips perfectly in sync with every word; real skin texture with pores, natural daylight from the side window on her face, loose hair strands that move slightly. Nothing stiff, nothing doll-like, nothing exaggerated.

She says each line exactly as written, only once, word for word, without repeating, adding or changing any word, and without "sí", "mhm", "um", "uh" or "eh". After her last line she says nothing else: she stays silent, listening, until the clip ends.

SCRIPT:

Línea 1: "Decorativo. Y sin tiempo pa’ gimnasio, ni dietas, ya estaba ahorrando pa’ operarme y bien caras que están."
Delivery: She only says her own lines, never the other person's questions or comments. The clip opens with her lips closed for about half a second, a dry knowing look at her friend; then she says the word "Decorativo" exactly one time, slowly and flatly, with a small single nod (it is spoken once, never echoed or doubled), and continues with "Y sin tiempo pa’ gimnasio...", exasperated, counting on her fingers, with a small eye roll at the end; she says "pa’" as "pa".

Línea 2: "¿Y eso dónde lo consigo?"
Delivery: curious, she leans a little toward the microphone with her eyebrows up; she says it only once, word for word.

Audio: she speaks in a natural Colombian Spanish accent from the Caribbean coast (costeño, like a woman from Barranquilla: sing-song, open vowels, she softens and sometimes drops the final s; never paisa, never neutral, never Mexican) at a quick, animated speed, with a bright, slightly high-pitched voice of a Colombian woman in her late 20s, confessional and self-deprecating, funny about her own problem; her pitch jumps up when she exaggerates and drops when she complains, like a real friend talking. The voice sounds like it's coming from a close podcast mic with little echo and reverberation. As her mouth moves away from the microphone, the audio changes in volume. Soft room tone of a small podcast studio, close-mic'd podcast sound.
motivo: revision de la app: Dijo «Decorativo» dos veces seguidas al empezar.
